evidence_boundary: Git and pull-request evidence only; not Product truth.
limitations: Git history is complete through the selected source commit; pull-request metadata is bounded to the 100 most recent merged pull requests returned by GitHub at acquisition time.
Pull requests are linked by their GitHub mergeCommit only; non-merge constituent commits were not requested.
Pull requests are included only when supplied metadata links them to an included commit.
Events created after the cutoff are excluded even when later repository state exposes them.
